# RDH Coaching

> Online personal training and fat loss coaching run by Rhys Hume. Based in Glasgow, Scotland, coaching clients worldwide. Built specifically around people who work desk jobs and have stopped moving.

## What it is

RDH Coaching is one to one online coaching. Every client gets a training programme built around their job, their injuries and the gym they actually use, nutrition that fits their real week, and a weekly check in where Rhys reviews their training videos, food and sleep and tells them what to change. Clients message Rhys directly. Coaching runs in blocks of 8 to 12 weeks.

## Who it is for

Mostly people with desk jobs who have stopped moving and want to lose fat and build muscle without living in the gym. Men and women. Complete beginners through to people who already train but have stalled. Coaching is delivered online, so location is not a limit. In person training is available in Glasgow.

## Coach

Rhys Hume. Glasgow based online physique and fat loss coach. Started training at 52kg, spent years training hard with little to show for it, and now coaches people so they do not have to learn it the long way. Has coached 100+ people, almost entirely online.

## Common questions

Does online coaching work as well as in person? For most people it works better. In person gets you a coach for one hour, leaving 167 hours a week unsupported. Online coaching covers the whole week.

How long until results show? Strength usually moves in the first two or three weeks. Visible changes tend to show around week six to eight.

What does it cost? Pricing is discussed on a call after an application. It works out at less per day than a supermarket meal deal.

How do you start? Fill in the short application at https://rdhcoaching.com. It takes about two minutes and requires no payment.
